name: Evern

facts.text: Level 76, 100,000 health, in Breifine (429883, 380409). Two to five Wraith Fairies come on a timer and cast a 1,000-point heal on their side.
He cannot be hurt outside his tether, resets after 30 seconds out of combat, and leaps to his target.
Bot chat: the fairies that land on his stones heal him; kill the fairies first; he is older than the frontier keeps.

story: Evern was standing in Breifine when the frontier was only hills, and the keeps were built around his ring of stones because nobody could move them, or him. He is a lord of the fairy kind, the Sylvan think, a great one gone strange with age, and the small wraith-fairies of the frontier are his. They drift in on the wind while he fights and settle on his stones, and from the stones they pour their healing into him. He does not chase so much as arrive: one moment across the ring, the next at his enemy's throat. Some of the old frontier hands believe he sits on a lid, and that what lies under Breifine is worse than he is.
legend: Fairies first, every one, before they land and heal him. The whole raid looks for wraith fairies while the tanks hold Evern. He leaps to whoever he picks, so healers spread out. Fight him at his stones; drag him off and nothing hurts him. Keep the fight going or he resets in half a minute.

phases.text: Little ones, to the stones. Mend me.

slay: The fairies will dance on you.

lairEntry: A ring of stones. Small lights land and rise.

phases.text: Wraith fairies drift down onto the stones!
